wholePhysicalScope: OSM castle way 108248588 fixes the full fortification perimeter. The identified first and second gates are nodes 10291824327 and 4963292368. Museum way 685004316 sets the long inner wing.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the tapered ridge perimeter, rising limestone walls, entrance approaches and courtyard museum.
limitations: Wall heights, minor terrace arrangement, material hues and stone loss vary across the monument and are approximated.
The interior is represented by the entrance passage, open court, aboveground room walls and the exterior of the museum wing.
